reviews.review: Love this game, incredibly fun even more so in co-op

Go watch trailers to this game.
Hear this music? Those adrenaline pumping beats and riffs? 
That music is what this whole game is like to play.
It's a blast, a rush. "What if Doom 16 had a sequel that is not sh1t and also a roguelite".
When you get into the proper pace it's non stop action. 
Even "RPG" roguelite elements don't stop you for more than a second, everything is "on the fly".
Absolutely beautiful weapons, nutty gunplay. 
Decent variety of builds to go for but not as "in-depth" and RNG dependant like GRF. This one is more about mechanical skill. Just get a gun you like and put it to good use.
And the music - oh the music - it's beautiful and accompanies the gameplay so well. Can't imagine this game without this music.
Only downsides: very WIP. Misses visible chunks of content. Ends on a "to be continued". What's there the can be beaten in 30-50 minutes (which you probably won't do on first run) + there's usual grind meta progression that I really wish wasn't there. And whole RPG part is rather WIP and I'm not sure devs have a clear idea of what to even do with it, but I hope they'll [strike]ditch it and focus on guns[/strike] figure it out.
not a ton of content yet, but still fun and worth the price.

Highly recommend getting this. It's a mix of Borderlands style, with gameplay that'll feel familiar if you've played Gunfire Reborn.

I still play both, because they DO feel different although they draw on quite a few similarities, namely the weapons' elemental damage types and the secret side areas, typically off to the side and that require a platforming or fighting challenge, and some also in secret areas that typically end with some nice loot or a buff to an aspect of your build.

Very fun and well polished for Early Access. I came a few days before the Spring Update came out(from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0) and i can't wait for the later plans as well as 1.0 and beyond!

And it being a roguelite, I haven't even scratched the surface on later levels, but I'm excited to work my way there for sure!
